objective: Compare a pretrained agricultural baseline and small-object candidate recall against the actual existing SAM 3.1 + Muse Spark pipeline, before deciding on classifier-head training. Video work is paused.

splits.development: Existing 5 official train images; agricultural checkpoint may have trained on them. Parameter selection only, never held-out results.
splits.published_diagnostic: Existing 20 official validation images; previously inspected error set, paired comparisons, not a fresh untouched test.
splits.new_confirmatory: 20 image-disjoint official val images selected by SHA256(recognition-v2-20261103:filename), excluding all previous images and smoke frame, before new inference. No farm-generalization claim.

agricultural_baseline.training: Published pretrained weights; no training by us.
agricultural_baseline.normalization: Official per-image RGB channel mean/std; full 1024 RGB input.

metrics.matching: Class-agnostic one-to-one greedy IoU >= .5, identical to existing benchmark. All annotated plants including partial border instances stay in denominator.
metrics.small_target_bins: GT bbox maximum side <=32px, 33-64px, 65-128px, >128px at original image resolution. Fixed before results.
metrics.semantic: Pixel IoU for ERFNet; reported separately, never compared to box recall as if same metric.
metrics.classification: Weed precision, recall, crop-as-weed, uncertainty; same candidate boxes isolate classification effects.

selection: Choose candidate geometry and ERFNet instance adapter only using development data. Freeze selection before final evaluation. New confirmatory images never inform thresholds.
guardrails: No classifier training before baseline and recall results.
No video edits, fabricated successes, tracking/GPS/hardware claims.
Keep original model output, human review and source provenance separate.
